title: Finance Director Stole $3.9M from Bay Area Housing Fund, Got 1 Year in Prison

claims.claim: Embezzled nearly $3.9 million from the Association of Bay Area Governments between 2011-2015, affecting affordable housing developments including Rincon Hill highrise and Windemere Ranch housing projects
